newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh IDLC to offer 1:1 bonus,35 pct div.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh IDLC to offer 1:1 bonus,35 pct div.

text.p: Industrial Development Leasing Company of Bangladesh Ltd (IDLC) on Thursday proposed a one-for-one bonus and 35 percent dividend for the year ended on December 31, 1996, brokers said.
The 1995 dividend also was 35 percent. The book closure will begin on April 5 and end on April 13.

The company's annual general meeting is scheduled for April 13. Brokers said the price of the scrip might rise as the circuit breaker or caps on price movement had been relaxed to 15 percent from 10 percent for three days starting on Thursday. The 100-taka IDLC share was traded at 4,568 taka on Wednesday.
